question: Which V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically, how many ALD cycles gave the thicker film, and did the potential shifts differ between them?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%cycle%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%mV%' OR text ILIKE '%shift%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, sentence_text FROM (SELECT id, page, text AS sentence_text FROM sentences WHERE text ILIKE '%cycle%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%mV%' OR text ILIKE '%shift%') t

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3,4,5,6) AND (text ILIKE '%ALD%' OR text ILIKE '%cycles%' OR text ILIKE '%40 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%80 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%thick%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, text FROM sentences WHERE text ILIKE '%ΔEeq%' OR text ILIKE '%40 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%80 nm%' OR text ILIKE '%thickness%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, quantity FROM measures WHERE sentence ILIKE '%ΔEeq%' OR sentence ILIKE '%40 nm%' OR sentence ILIKE '%80 nm%' OR sentence ILIKE '%ALD cycles%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%cycle%' OR text ILIKE '%nm%' OR text ILIKE '%40 %' ORDER BY id

SELECT id, text, value, unit, role FROM measures WHERE array_to_string(quantity, ' ') ILIKE '%thick%' OR array_to_string(quantity, ' ') ILIKE '%potential%' OR array_to_string(about, ' ') ILIKE '%V2O5%' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, line_no, text, conf FROM figure_ocr WHERE figure_id='p2.F1' ORDER BY line_no
